sections.text: This quarter was marked by moderate volatility in caustic soda pricing. Our plant in Baton Rouge increased output 5% after completing maintenance. We modified our supply agreement with Delta Chemicals, extending the contract with updated volume commitments. We lost our customer Gulf Coast Refining as they terminated the relationship and switched to a competitor.

Jane: What is the outlook for caustic soda pricing? Carl: We expect pricing to remain moderately volatile for the next quarter. Jane: How does this impact your agreement with Delta Chemicals? Carl: The modified terms actually benefit us with higher minimum volumes.
